clue.text: American city with a moving population?

definitions.meaning: a population that moves about is ..., not settled

explanation.definitionFit: The Alabama port shares its name with the adjective for people or things able to move freely.

clue.text: Of course it could be seafood

definitions.text: Of course it could be seafood

parts.words: Of course it could be seafood
parts.note: a meal's central course could well be fish; the 'main' is also the sea, so a dish from the main is seafood

explanation.surface: A remark that something served may well turn out to be fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The principal course of a meal is its chief plate, and fish is a common choice for it.

clue.text: Night flier of the bird family native to Indonesia

parts.note: a bat flies by night
avian means relating to birds

explanation.surface: A nocturnal creature of the bird kind found in Indonesia.
explanation.walkthrough: Batavia was the Dutch colonial name for Jakarta, so a Batavian is someone from there.
explanation.definitionFit: Batavia was the colonial capital of the Dutch East Indies, the old name for Jakarta in Java.

clue.text: Wild cat should be on a chain, it sounds

indicators.note: the phrase tells us the word we want is only heard like the word for chain parts

parts.note: links are the rings joined to make a chain

explanation.surface: A warning that a dangerous feline ought to be kept chained up.
explanation.definitionFit: A lynx is a short-tailed wild feline of northern forests.

clue.text: A divinely expressed wish?

parts.note: a farewell wish for success that invokes the deity, read as a wish 'expressed' with God in it

explanation.surface: A blessing spoken with divine help.
explanation.definitionFit: An old farewell meaning 'may God prosper you', wishing a traveller success.

clue.text: Propose Conservative case for church funds

parts.note: to propose something is to offer it
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party
a box is a case or container

explanation.surface: A Tory politician suggests a case for raising money for the church.
explanation.definitionFit: The box in a church into which the congregation drops collection money.

clue.text: Dispatched and left in sewer without hesitation

indicators.note: the word for left is placed inside what remains of sewer
the hesitation sound is removed from the word sewer

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone was killed and dumped down a drain without a moment's pause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sewer' looks like a drain in the surface, but it is cut by 'without' (losing the hesitation sound) to leave a word for stitch, and 'in' houses the left letter inside that.
explanation.definitionFit: Slew is the past tense of slay, and to dispatch someone is to kill them.

clue.text: Takes from the Bible?

parts.note: ex is Latin for from, as in 'ex works'
Acts is a book of the New Testament

explanation.surface: Borrowing words from scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: To exact is to demand and take something, such as payment or obedience.

clue.text: Almighty, it used to be claimed in Clackmannan

definitions.meaning: the phrase 'the almighty ...' names money as all-powerful

definitions.text: it used to be claimed in Clackmannan
definitions.meaning: A town in the Scottish county of Clackmannanshire

explanation.definitionFit: The US currency is called 'almighty' in a set phrase, and a small Scottish town in Clackmannanshire bears the same name.

clue.text: Concentrated living under canvas

definitions.meaning: someone concentrated is focused and determined on something
a camper sleeps in a tent

explanation.definitionFit: Intent means fixed in attention, and split as 'in tent' it describes a camper.

clue.text: Came last, despite great expectations

definitions.meaning: coming after every other runner is finishing behind them all
the phrase used when something happens in spite of what was expected

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means 'nevertheless', and split literally it says behind everyone else.

clue.text: Flares illuminating the streets of Calcutta?

definitions.text: Flares illuminating the streets of Calcutta?

parts.words: Flares illuminating the streets of Calcutta?
parts.note: Calcutta is in the Indian region of Bengal, so its street lamps would be lights of that region; the real thing is a kind of coloured flare

explanation.surface: Fireworks lighting up an Indian city at night.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bengal light is a blue firework flare once used for signalling.

clue.text: Peaceful emblem right off a Channel port

indicators.note: the letter for right comes off the port's name

parts.note: Dover is the English port on the Strait of Dover

explanation.surface: A peace symbol dropped from a ferry port.
explanation.walkthrough: DOVER is the English Channel ferry port; 'off' removes its R.
explanation.definitionFit: A white bird of this kind is the traditional symbol of peace.

clue.text: Girl for a quiet nobleman

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet
an earl is a British nobleman

explanation.surface: A young woman chosen for a reserved aristocrat.
explanation.definitionFit: Pearl is a female given name.

clue.text: Place to sow wild oats in ancient Greece?

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of the word oats run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Where young Greeks went to have their fling.
explanation.walkthrough: A stoa was a covered colonnade in ancient Greece, so 'in ancient Greece' places the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoa was a roofed portico in Greek cities, a public walkway and meeting spot.

clue.text: Strict partisan showing energy in drill

indicators.note: the energy word is placed inside the drill word

parts.note: a bit is the cutting part of a drill
go means energy or vigour

explanation.surface: A fanatic puts energy into army training.
explanation.definitionFit: A bigot is intolerantly devoted to his own party or opinions.

clue.text: Come again about a dog

parts.note: re means about, concerning
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: Calling a dog back.
explanation.definitionFit: To recur is to happen again or return.

clue.text: Might help in the long run

definitions.text: Might help in the long run

parts.words: Might help in the long run
parts.note: a runner's strength over distance is what helps in a long race; read as 'eventually', it seems to mean something else

explanation.surface: Advice that something may prove useful eventually.
explanation.definitionFit: Endurance, the ability to keep going over a long effort.

clue.text: one that may jump at Barbara Woodhouse's command

definitions.text: one that may jump at Barbara Woodhouse's command

parts.words: one that may jump at Barbara Woodhouse's command
parts.note: Barbara Woodhouse was a famous British dog trainer on television; this breed of spaniel is named for leaping to flush game

explanation.surface: An obedient creature responding to a famous trainer.
explanation.definitionFit: A springer is a spaniel breed, a dog a trainer like Woodhouse would command.

clue.text: Wise girl?

parts.note: a female name that is also a word for good sense

explanation.surface: A sensible young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Prudence is a female name and also means wisdom or care.

clue.text: One warm garment an insomniac could count on

definitions.text: One warm garment an insomniac could count on

parts.words: One warm garment an insomniac could count on
parts.note: a knitted sweater, and also a sheep leaping a fence, the creature sleepless people count

explanation.surface: A sweater a sleepless person relies on.
explanation.definitionFit: A woollen sweater, and a sheep that jumps, as counted by those who cannot sleep.

clue.text: Where the vicar is at home with a capital H

definitions.text: Where the vicar is at home

parts.note: Paris is the capital of France

explanation.surface: The vicar's home district, spelt with a capital H.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a capital H' reads as an upper-case letter, but 'a capital' is PARIS and H is added.
explanation.definitionFit: The district served by a vicar's church is his patch of the diocese.

clue.text: Strike against work on East Berlin's barricade

indicators.note: a down clue's work placed 'on' the barricade follows it here, written after the wall piece

parts.note: the Berlin Wall divided East from West Berlin
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Industrial action against work on the Berlin Wall.
explanation.definitionFit: To wallop someone is to hit them hard.

clue.text: Just open for a drink

parts.note: a jar is British slang for a drink of beer

explanation.surface: A pub open only for a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'jar' is British slang for a glass of beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A door slightly open is said to be ajar.

clue.text: Mason's collaborator on the borderline

definitions.meaning: Charles Mason surveyed a colonial American boundary with his partner Jeremiah
the Mason line marking the boundary between Pennsylvania and Maryland carries both surveyors' names

explanation.definitionFit: Jeremiah Dixon co-surveyed the Mason-Dixon line, the boundary between American states.

clue.text: Vanilla's blue dye

indicators.note: the 's reads as 'has', so the word holds the answer within it

explanation.surface: Vanilla mixed with a blue colouring.
explanation.definitionFit: Anil is indigo, a blue dye from a West Indian shrub.

clue.text: Speak sharply in game

definitions.meaning: a children's card game of matching pairs

explanation.definitionFit: To bark a curt remark, and the card game where matching cards are called out.

clue.text: Light opera description of a hot line

indicators.note: a description recasts something in other terms, so the letters of the phrase are recast

explanation.surface: A comic operetta portraying a heated telephone link.
explanation.walkthrough: 'description of' signals rearranging A HOT LINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Iolanthe is a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera.

clue.text: Tchaikovsky's Eugene a man of little spirit, apparently

definitions.meaning: Tchaikovsky's opera, after Pushkin, is named for its hero Eugene

definitions.text: a man of little spirit, apparently
definitions.meaning: split, the name sounds like a single measure of gin, little spirit

explanation.definitionFit: The title character of Tchaikovsky's opera, whose name also splits into a single tot of liquor.

clue.text: Faith and Charity lost without their sister?

parts.note: faith, hope and charity are the three virtues, so the third is their sister
less means without, as in 'penniless'

explanation.surface: Two of the virtues are lost once the third is gone.
explanation.walkthrough: Faith, Hope and Charity are the three theological virtues and also girls' names, so Hope is the sister.
explanation.definitionFit: A lost cause is one beyond any chance of success.

clue.text: Scratch scores in the Home Counties few and far between

indicators.note: the golf scores are placed inside the regional abbreviation

parts.note: SE, the South East of England, holds the Home Counties around London
a scratch golfer scores par on each hole, so pars are scratch scores

explanation.surface: Golf handicaps in the commuter belt are rare.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the counties surrounding London, in the South East (SE).
explanation.definitionFit: Something scattered thinly is scarce and widely spaced.
